records_trimmed.excerpt: Within a Phase 1 pharmacokinetic drug-drug interaction (DDI) study, we concurrently implemented an additional study arm incorporating decentralized elements to evaluate feasibility, data integrity, and participant perceptions compared to conventional on-site procedures. In this open-label, hybrid DCT, 20 healthy adults were randomized in a 1:1 ratio to either the DCT arm or the conventional arm.
